px_per_m_note.what_this_number_is: orthographic screen pixels per metre of SCREEN-VERTICAL world extent: Camera3D.size = view_px / this. It is NOT camera.json's px_per_m, which is projected crown-to-sole pixels per metre of CHARACTER HEIGHT. The two differ by roughly cos(elevation).
